public_source_inventory.hash_basis: Exact published JSON file bytes; per-file raw SHA256 values inside.

method: Every raw file was independently passed through git hash-object --stdin-paths without object writes. All but three unchanged parent blobs match their committed tree after current clean conversion; those three retain exact raw/committed byte equality and are explicitly classified. SHA256 of committed bytes comes from binary git cat-file --batch. Custom clean filters and working-tree encodings are unset; configured line-ending normalization is retained.
limitations: Byte reconciliation only; no runtime pass, semantic quality, deployment or optional activation is inferred.
